title: Machine Generated Text: A Comprehensive Survey of Threat Models and Detection Methods
reasoning: The paper is explicitly guided by the EU Ethics Guidelines for Trustworthy AI (TAI) and integrates sociotechnical and human-centric ethical considerations throughout its analysis. One of its major stated contributions is the exploration of threat models and detection systems through the lens of ethics and trust impacts, including detailed discussions on fairness, accountability, and the moral implications of AI-driven deception.
